subject: Packaging options for security add-ons — phased evidence credits and HSM plan
messages:
From: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@arcwell.health>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Arcwell Procurement <procurement@arcwell.health>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Packaging options for security add-ons — evidence credits question

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team at Arcwell is aligned on Redwood's latency/cost profile, and we're ready to start a pilot. Before we lock terms, procurement has a couple of questions around how you package compliance/security add-ons and how implementation credits would be handled. Key asks below: 

- Audit log retention: we need 24 months of immutable logs retained in EU region for a subset of data. How do you price retention tiers and is there a discount if we commit to multiple regions?
- KMS/HSM: we expect to require managed KMS (customer-managed keys) and a small number of HSM seats for FIPS-backed signing. Can you outline seat vs throughput pricing and any pilot credits?
- Evidence & attestation delivery: for SOC/HIPAA evidence delivery and attestation support, procurement prefers milestone-based credits (pilot → onboarding → steady state). Do you amortize implementation fees or issue credits against invoices?

We've attached a short RFP excerpt with our requirements (Arcwell_RFP_requirements.pdf). Can you provide a compact options matrix for: (A) seat-based + monthly audit surcharge, (B) throughput-based + one-time implementation credit amortized, and (C) a hybrid laddered-credit approach that phases down credits over 12 months?

If you can turn around a one-page options summary this week, we can route it through legal and procurement.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Kim
Director of IT Procurement
Arcwell Health

Attachments: Arcwell_RFP_requirements.pdf (pdf, 42KB)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>

Subject: Re: Packaging options for security add-ons — evidence credits and HSM plan

Hi Sarah — really appreciate the clear asks and the RFP excerpt. High level answers inline, and I'll attach a short worksheet we use to model the three packaging options.

Quick summary (details in attached spreadsheet):
- Audit log retention: priced as tiered add-on (0-90 days / 90-365 / 365-730 / 730+). EU-region retention carries a regional surcharge (network + storage delta). If you commit to multi-region (US+EU), we can discount the EU surcharge by 30% on the first 12 months as part of a pilot-to-scale concession.

- KMS/HSM: two flavors — managed KMS (per key per month) and HSM seats (annual seat or throughput-based token signing). For pilots we usually offer: one complimentary HSM admin seat for 90 days + 50% off first 3 months of managed KMS. For enterprise pilots we can convert that concession to a milestone credit instead of straight discount.

- Evidence & attestation credits: we support both amortization (spread SOW implementation fee over N months as invoice credits) and milestone credits (credit applied on approved deliverable). Our recommended pattern for customers like Arcwell is a laddered-credit approach:
  * Pilot phase (0–3 months): 100% implementation credit up to agreed cap (covers onboarding/config & first evidence package)
  * Ramp phase (4–12 months): 50% credit applied monthly against usage/addons up to cap
  * Steady state (13+ months): credit ends; ongoing surcharge applies (we can set a transitioning surcharge with a 6-month rollback window to prevent cliffing)

Trade-offs to highlight: amortization is simpler for procurement accounting (one line item spread across invoices). Milestone credits give you better control over deliverables and encourage on-time evidence handoffs from our delivery team.

Attached: security-addons-pricing-v1.xlsx — it includes three scenario tabs (Seat-based; Throughput-based; Laddered-credit hybrid) with sample economics and suggested caps.

If agreeable I can put together a one-pager options matrix + short SOW sketch and loop in Legal next week. Proposed next steps:
1) I share a 1-pager + SOW sketch by Thursday 14 Aug.
2) Arcwell reviews; we sync for 30m to pick preferred path.
3) Legal drafts term sheet / addendum.

Happy to adjust the laddering mechanics — would you prefer more months on ramp or a softer 25% taper?

Best,
Rishi
VP, Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference

Attachments: security-addons-pricing-v1.xlsx (xlsx, 76KB)

Hi Sarah / Rishi — quick operational note from Delivery/CS perspective:

- Evidence cadence: we typically deliver SOC/HIPAA evidence in two bundles — (1) onboarding evidence pack (control mappings, initial logs snapshot, keying docs) and (2) steady-state attestation support (quarterly updates). For the laddered credit plan, we recommend tying the Pilot 100% credit to completion of the onboarding evidence pack (clear acceptance criteria: control mapping sign-off + test ingestion for audit logs).
- Implementation SOW: to avoid invoice disputes, we'll include a simple milestone table in the SOW with acceptance definitions and a credit cap line. We can also include a 30-day remediation window after a failed evidence review before the credit is considered unused.
- HSM ops: one operational caveat — HSM seat provisioning lead time is ~3-4 weeks once the PO and any access paperwork are finalized. If you want the complimentary admin seat during the pilot, please confirm by PO submission or the seat will be reserved on a first-come basis.

If helpful, I can draft the SOW milestone table and embed it in the one-pager Rishi is preparing.

Cheers,
Monica
Principal Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
